grammar-de-sconj-citation-dass.explanation: The input explicitly labels dass as a subordinating conjunction, so the route identity and Citation oracle are unambiguous. The prompt already resolves a complete single-word SCONJ when context establishes that identity and separately rejects only an ambiguous bare label; the model nevertheless returned Unresolved while both contextual dass cases passed. This isolated over-conservatism is an accepted model limitation, not a prompt or corpus/evaluator defect.
